keyFindings.description: receiveUp compares the term's subscription connection with clientConn, which only the receiver's reconnect hook updates, and runReconnectHooks stops at the first failing hook (internal/bus/recovery.go), with the KV rewatch hook registered before receiver.reconnected (main.go:1314, 1472). When nats.go closes the connection and recovery installs a new one, Connected() reads true; if the rewatch keeps failing, clientConn and subscribed.conn both still name the closed connection, so the signal reads up and the holder keeps renewing with no subscription, without bound, while /healthz answers 503 'subscription inactive'. Before 6828bbb3 the signal checked sub.IsValid() and released after the bound. Compare with the client's current connection read without a lock (the connectedConn atomic).

The connected flag is set first in ReconnectedCB, which then runs onReconnect (restoreSubscriptions and the reconnect hooks, real requests) on nats.go's single async-callback goroutine; a disconnect that happens meanwhile has its DisconnectedErrCB queued behind it, so Connected() and receiveUp read up until the hooks give up. The deep review reproduced Connected() reading true 12.19 s after a cut during a hook, against the 3 s bound: on a flapping route the take-over goes past 15 s. Before 6828bbb3 Connected() read the live status. Keep the flag's updates off that queue (run the reconnect work on the client's own goroutine, or take the status from nc.StatusChanged with its drop caveats).
'about 13 s later' leaves out up to 1 s before the lease's step first reads the signal down: about 3 + 1 + 3 + 0.5 + 7 = 14.5 s plus subscribe and delivery; the changelog fragment says the same.
noteConnection(nc, false) on a dialed-but-never-installed connection can change nothing (connectedConn only ever holds an installed connection); delete it and the field doc's sentence that lists it.

releaseReceiveLost: the !held guard cannot be true (step read held in the same goroutine), its tail repeats giveUp's (one standDown helper), and releasedRecordLocked(true) passes lapsed=true for a term that has not lapsed; name the parameter for what it forces.
A fourth optional callback joins three positional parameter lists (options, connect, connectWithContext) with seven nil call-site edits; one callbacks struct.
